purpose: Research scheduled competitive or playable gambling events and map verified facts into the Gamblee Event CPT while preserving the existing listing-card layout.

routing.event: Scheduled competitive/playable campaigns: slot or poker tournaments, freerolls, leaderboards, casino races and scheduled bingo rooms/sessions. A qualifying deposit does not move these out of Events.
routing.promotion: Prize draws, raffles, giveaways, sweepstakes, random-winner competitions, missions/challenges, cashback, loyalty mechanics, prize wheels and mystery boxes remain Promotions even when time-limited or deposit-gated.
routing.bonus: Direct deterministic signup/new-customer rewards, or direct deterministic rewards whose claim requires a fresh upfront deposit, remain Bonuses unless an Event or Promotion override applies.

principles: One event object represents one discrete scheduled campaign or recurring event series.
Respect the existing Event listing card: headline prize pool/jackpot, entry badge, no more than three compact info rows, countdown/status and CTA.
card.rows contains the three most useful listing facts only. Put deeper qualification and scoring mechanics in structured fields and terms.
Use event_categories for the event mechanic and vertical separately for casino, betting, bingo or poker.
Markets and currencies are independent. Store exact markets even though the legacy Event runtime still mirrors currency buckets for backwards compatibility.
provider_group is optional and uses the provider taxonomy. When set, the event may cover that provider group; event_brand remains the CTA owner.
Do not use Events for prize draws, giveaways or other random-winner campaigns merely because they have dates.
Prefer current first-party evidence. Current specific secondary evidence may fill commercial mechanics when first-party material is unavailable or inaccessible.

Keep an established event_key stable across revisions. event_key is the idempotency key: when event_id is omitted but event_key matches exactly one existing Event in the supplied brand/provider scope, the importer reconciles it automatically.

Return one event_reconciliation row for every existing Event supplied to research: confirmed when current evidence shows it remains live, ended only with affirmative evidence it ended/was withdrawn/was replaced, and not_found when current research could not verify it. not_found never retires anything.
schema_gaps is reserved for Event-classified mechanics that cannot be represented faithfully.
